messages:
amanda-support: New customer VelvetApps signed up via OIDC and reports there is no API key visible in their console. Account id acct_ve_7b3, expected project slug: velvet-prod. Can someone check the onboarding provisioner? Sara attached screenshots: https://redwood.screens/abc123
liam-ops: Can you paste the signup trace id and any UI error they saw? Also whether they used GitHub or Google OIDC.
amanda-support: trace=signup-20240403-91a, they used GitHub OIDC. UI shows "No API keys" and the console call to GET /v1/projects returned empty list for that org.
provisioner-bot: [event] provisioner.create_key request_id=prv-0a1b2 time=2024-04-03T16:12:10Z status=created service_account=svc-onboard-123 project=redwood-internal-prod
devon-infra: :eyes: provisioner created the key under redwood-internal-prod, not the customer project. Grep the provisioner logs for the trace: ```kubectl logs deploy/provisioner -n infra | grep prv-0a1b2 -A3 -B3``` Copy from logs: "group_claim=velvet-apps-org" then "mapped_project=redwood-internal-prod"
liam-ops: That mapping is wrong — our group->project mapper regex was recently tightened. It can mis-handle hyphenated org names or trailing dots. velvet-apps-org should map to velvet-prod.
amanda-support: Customer confirms org claim was `velvet-apps` (no trailing dot). They expect `velvet-prod` project to be created and bound.
devon-infra: Quick workaround: I can rebind the key to their project and revoke the incorrectly-scoped one. Will do manual fix and open a bug.
ops-oncall: Doing manual rebind now. Steps: 1) create key bound to velvet-prod 2) revoke old key in redwood-internal-prod 3) log audit entry.
ops-oncall: Manual rebind complete. New API key for acct_ve_7b3 created and bound to velvet-prod. Key (masked): sk-••••••••abcd. Old key revoked in redwood-internal-prod.
sara-cs: Sent the new key to the customer over their approved secure channel and asked them to test.
amanda-support: Customer confirmed test calls succeed (200) and embeddings look good. :thumbsup:
devon-infra: Filing bug PROV-4221 — mapper regex fails for hyphenated group ids. Plan: revert to previous parsing logic, add unit tests for hyphens and dots, and add an integration test that simulates GitHub OIDC claims.
liam-ops: cc @security for audit of the revoked key and the temporary key distribution.
ops-oncall: Audit entries added (audit_id=AUD-9938) and incident ticket created INC-8342 for impact tracking.
amanda-support: I'll keep the thread open until the PR is merged. Thanks everyone.
devon-infra: PR opened: https://git.redwood/provisioner/merge/1223 — includes fix and tests.
amanda-support: Great, closing this once CI passes and we roll the patch. Thanks all!
